judgement.reason: Development results: mean input+output tokens increased 29.1% (906,258 to 1,169,589), and success fell from 3/3 to 1/3. The tool was used successfully in 24 calls, but neither the 3/3 task-success requirement nor the ≥20% token-reduction requirement was met. These three seeds do not establish generalization.

On these DEVELOPMENT trials, mean input+output tokens increased 51.0% (906,258 to 1,368,014), and success fell from 3/3 to 2/3. The tool was used successfully 15 times, but neither the 3/3 success requirement nor the ≥20% token reduction was met. Three seeds do not establish generalization.
